purpose: correctness smoke of benchmarks/vibe/hms through VIBE's single-run entry point; QPS is not comparable (macOS, no CPU pinning, no competitors)
hms: holographic-vsa wheel built from this branch (base 15b87db) with maturin 1.15.0, rustc 1.96.0
dataset: random-xs-20-cosine: the train/test rows of ann-benchmarks random-xs-20-angular (9,000 / 1,000) in VIBE's HDF5 layout, exact top-100 ground truth by VIBE's cosine distance
why_not_run_py: run.py (even --local) calls os.sched_getaffinity and taskset/numactl, which macOS lacks; run_algorithm.py is the per-run entry point run.py launches
commands: python run_algorithm.py --dataset random-xs-20-cosine --algorithm hms --module vibe.algorithms.hms --constructor HMS --count 100 --runs 2 '["cosine", 32, 500]' <the 33 [ef, rerank] pairs of config.yml>
runs: 1 build (degree 32, build_ef 500) x 33 query settings, k=100, no errors
